Note
Game fountain donation glitch

Donating more than you have still counts towards the target, as if you and Ghosh donated. E.g. If you have less than 1000G and decide to donate 1000G, game will still count a donation of 2001G (Ghosh matches your donation plus 1G). Fountain is built when total donations are at least 3000G after you make a donation which you can afford. If you make donations total go to 3000G+ without actually donating and leave town, Nico will not spawn anymore in Town and you will NOT be able to build Fountain. But if you have less than 1000G, you can donate 1000G twice and then immediately (without leaving town) donate 1G. That is enough to build Fountain and can be done in one day, rather than normal at least 2 days.
